CustomField.formula: IF( FLOOR((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime)) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime))) & " Days ", "" ) & IF( FLOOR(MOD((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime) * 24, 24)) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(MOD((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime) * 24, 24))) & " Hours ", "" ) & IF( FLOOR(MOD((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime) * 24 * 60, 60)) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(MOD((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime) * 24 * 60, 60))) & " Minutes ", "" ) & TEXT(ROUND(MOD((AcceptDateTime - RequestDateTime) * 24 * 60 * 60, 60), 0)) & " Seconds"
CustomField.label: Wait Time
